cleared.check: BNB Chain binary-only state structures on the persistent storage path, read from the v1.8.2 source (raw.githubusercontent.com/bnb-chain/bsc/v1.8.2/core/state/journal.go, state_object.go, statedb.go) and the binary: storageChangePool (sync.Pool of *storageChange), journal.storageEntries, stateReadList (BAL access list), stateReaderWithCache (the Hertz fix read cache behind needBadSharedStorage) and the trie prefetcher.
cleared.result: A reverted write cannot reach any of them. The pool hands out a fresh entry per SetState and only takes entries back in journal.reset at the end of the transaction, when the journal entries are dropped as well; journal.copy builds its entries from the pool but keeps an empty storageEntries, so copied entries are never returned. stateReadList records keys read, not values. stateReaderWithCache and the prefetcher serve and warm committed values only; writes stay in dirtyStorage until Finalise. The binary journal.append at 0x10be9c2 compares the itab with go:itab.*storageChange and appends to journal+0x40, matching the source.

cleared.check: L-1225: bor v2.11.2 64-byte keccak cache in opKeccak256 (core/vm/instructions.go:265-278 at tag v2.11.2), read from the amd64 and arm64 binaries and run in the models (scripts/kk.py, seed 32_1225_01).
cleared.result: The cache is vm.BoundedCache[[64]uint8, common.Hash], built per block by newSharedBlockCaches (core/blockchain.go:1268-1289 at v2.11.2) and shared by the prefetcher goroutine and all BlockSTM V2 workers through vm.Config; it is not process-wide. Load calls sync.(*Map).Load and Store calls internal/sync HashTrieMap.LoadOrStore after two runtime.convTnoptr calls that box copies of the 64-byte key and the 32-byte value; the count is an atomic add (lock xadd on amd64, ldaxr/stlxr or ldaddal on arm64). opKeccak256 passes the key and evm.hasherBuf by value on the stack (amd64 0xb4dc22-0xb4dc84), so the stored value is a copied array, not a slice into hasherBuf. The key type is [64]uint8 with TFlagRegularMemory and equal function memequal_varlen with size word 64, so lookup hashes and compares all 64 bytes. bor-amd64: 5000 sequences, 86963 hashes, 17028 cache hits, 52663 misses, 24613 stores, 8254 LoadOrStore that found the other worker's entry, 17272 hasherBuf overwrites, 2021 runs at a small cap, 0 mismatches, 0 errors; bor-arm64: 2000 sequences, 35096 hashes, 6836 cache hits, 21199 misses, 9918 stores, 3302 LoadOrStore that found the other worker's entry, 7061 hasherBuf overwrites, 812 runs at a small cap, 0 mismatches, 0 errors. Two workers with separate hasherBuf share one cache; inputs of other lengths overwrite a worker hasherBuf between its Store and the other worker Load; a stored entry from the other worker between Load and Store is found by LoadOrStore and not counted twice. Every result equals Keccak-256 of the input. CurrencyDelta.sol:14 hashes 64 bytes and goes through this cache; Position.sol:60 hashes 58 bytes and does not.

cleared.check: bor v2.11.2 ParallelStateDB (BlockSTM V2 worker state) storage, transient storage and revert, read from raw.githubusercontent.com/0xPolygon/bor/v2.11.2/core/state/parallel_statedb.go, parallel_statedb_journal.go and parallel_statedb_validate.go; its transient path also ran from the binary (first entry).
cleared.result: SetState journals the previous value with a flag for whether the slot was already in localStorage; revert puts the previous value back when it was, and deletes the local entry otherwise, so reads fall through to the MV store or base state, which hold the transaction-start value. FlushToMVStore publishes only localStorage, so a reverted write is not published; its key stays in WriteKeys, which only drives MarkEstimate and CleanupEstimate. GetCommittedState caches the first read of the MV store or base and is not touched by local writes. Transient storage is a fresh map from Prepare per transaction and is restored with transientStorage.Set. RevertToSnapshot uses the same id lookup as StateDB and truncates journal, balance ops, logs and transfers. Validation compares writer and incarnation, or the value. No step reads a reverted value.

leadResults.answer: Per-block cache shared by the prefetcher and BlockSTM V2 workers; sync.Map plus atomic count; key and value boxed as copied arrays; full 64-byte compare. Modelled interleavings and two planted faults; no wrong hash.

Transient path of bsc, bor (StateDB and ParallelStateDB) and avalanchego binaries on both architectures, and the bsc persistent path, match pyevm on every read; faults caught. bor and avalanchego persistent storage were not modelled from the binary.
The Nitro persistent storage revert was not lifted this cycle; the live reverted-swap probe on Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain again returned the reference bytes.
